subject: Marketplace Private Offer — structure, rev-share & billing term approval request
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@fintechco.com>, Brad Chen <brad.chen@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-04-10T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace private offer request — FinTechCo (draft commercial + rev-share ask)

Team — looping you in on a fast-moving FinTechCo opportunity. They want a private offer via AWS Marketplace and have provided their forecast and PO intent (attached). Key asks from the buyer and AWS AM: 

- 24-month committed subscription for Redwood Standard (multi-node inference)
- Upfront 30% prepayment; remainder monthly usage; buyer requests Net45 billing terms
- Marketplace private-offer with a marketplace rev-share of 35% (AWS requests a high-level confirmation we accept the rev-share split for this private offer)
- Small concession on RMA/uptime warranty in exchange for guaranteed committed units

Attachments: FinTechCo_PRICING_v2.pdf (commercial), RevenueShare_Model.xlsx (calculation), AWS_PrivateOffer_Form_8573.pdf (AM provided).

Why this deal: FinTechCo is a strategic regional customer with clear expansion potential (payments product). This opens the APAC expansion pilot and is likely to drive a multi-year ARR expansion if we accept a slightly higher marketplace rev-share in year 1 to secure placement.

Ask: Can Deal Desk confirm 1) ability to publish this private offer with 35% rev-share, 2) accept Net45 terms (finance signoff), and 3) approve the nonstandard warranty language (legal to confirm) so I can reply to Erin and the AWS AM by EOD Tuesday?

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@fintechco.com>, Brad Chen <brad.chen@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer request — FinTechCo (draft commercial + rev-share ask)

Thanks Marcus — quick read and clarifying questions before we escalate: 

1) Rev-share: 35% is higher than our baseline for this SKU (baseline 30%). We can make exceptions for strategic expansion but need the model that shows net proceeds vs. list. I reviewed RevenueShare_Model.xlsx and the effective net to Redwood after marketplace fees + AWS commission + estimated tax/withholding looks like ~43% of list for year 1 given their prepayment. Need confirmation that the CSM/org will commit to milestone-based expansion to justify the concession.

2) Billing: Net45 is non-standard (we default to Net30 for marketplace flows). Finance (cc: laura_bennett) will need to sign off — marketplace settlement cadence can complicate cash flow. Please confirm deal-level ARR and growth plan.

3) Legal terms: What is the exact warranty language they ask to soften? If it's limited to a 30-day SLA carve-out for certain non-production clusters we might accept. If they want indemnity carve-outs, escalate to legal.

Next steps requested from Marcus: a 1-paragraph buyer justification for execs, and the exact clause they want removed/modified. If you can get Erin to confirm a 30% prepay (vs 30% upfront we show) and the list price anchor, that helps.

If we proceed, this will need an executive approval note for the margin hit (rev-share + Net45).

-rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Deal Desk Manager | Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer request — FinTechCo (exec note + recommended approval)

Evelyn / Laura — attaching a short commercial note and the ask from the buyer/AWS. Below is the one-paragraph buyer justification Rachel requested.

Buyer justification (for exec packet): FinTechCo is a mid-market payments platform with strong CAC payback and an immediate production use case for Redwood inference in transactional risk scoring. They plan an APAC pilot in Q3 contingent on marketplace availability and prefer to buy through AWS marketplace for procurement compliance. Approving a 24-month private offer with a 35% marketplace rev-share and Net45 billing in year 1 accelerates deployment timelines and unlocks a potential $2.1M ARR expansion over 24 months (conservative estimate) driven by cross-sell into their merchant network. We recommend approval conditioned on finance accepting Net45 for the first payment cycle and legal finalizing a limited warranty carve-out tied to non-production clusters only.

Commercial ask summary: 
- Term: 24 months
- Billing: 30% upfront (prepay), remainder monthly; buyer requests Net45 for monthly invoices
- Marketplace rev-share requested: 35% for the private offer (AM asks for explicit confirmation)
- Special terms: limited SLA carve-out for staging/non-prod, no indemnity changes requested

Attachments: FinTechCo_PRICING_v2.pdf, RevenueShare_Model.xlsx, AWS_PrivateOffer_Form_8573.pdf

If leadership is comfortable with the economics, please provide an approval reply so we can instruct AWS AM to publish the private offer and route DocuSign.

Thanks — Marcus

Date: 2027-04-12T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer request — FinTechCo (exec decision)

Approving with conditions — I have reviewed the one-pager and revenue model. I approve publication of the AWS private offer under the following conditions: 

1) Rev-share 35% accepted for YEAR 1 only; FYR we cap at 30% for renewal negotiations. Document this in the private-offer notes.
2) Finance (Laura) must sign off on Net45 for the first 60 days' cash-flow plan; if finance cannot accept, revert to Net30 for marketplace settlement.
3) Legal to approve the exact SLA carve-out (Rachel/Karthik, pls sync w/ legal). No indemnity changes allowed.
4) Sales to secure a signed commitment to the expansion milestones (Q3 APAC pilot acceptance) as a condition precedent in the SOW.

Marcus — please confirm you will get Erin to sign the expansion milestone commitment and that the AWS AM will attach the private-offer notes reflecting the time-limited rev-share concession. Once Laura confirms finance, we will route to Legal and DocuSign.

Evelyn Hart
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
